other_conditions: Applicant must have a valid commercial driving license before buying the vehicle
Applicant must provide a valid government ID proof with address (e.g., Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport)
Applicant must not be a defaulter at any financial institution
Association of farmers must be legally registered with the Government of Meghalaya (e.g., Cooperatives, Farmer Producer Companies, Farmer Producer Organisations)
Association must provide an Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate as applicable
Association must not be a defaulter at any financial institution
benefits_summary: Provides 50% financial assistance for purchasing commercial agriculture transport vehicles to eligible individuals and farmer associations, with up to 200 vehicles supported.
